Insurance plans we accept

Bring your insurance card to every visit. If your plan isn't listed, call the front desk before you book.

  • Aetna (PPO, HMO)
  • Blue Shield of the Bay (all plans)
  • Cigna Open Access
  • Medicare Part B
  • Harbor Health Partners HMO
  • Self-pay: preventive exam $180, sick visit $120
